column1: # qwen35 (qwen3_5, E=256, 40 layers): downstream cost of imposing rolling residency with NO adaptation. Ten 0-shot tasks, same harness and metric convention as olmoe_adapt_downstream.csv. 'free' is the published model; R8/R32 switch the constraint on at eval time only. BPB on the audited slice is recomputed per arm from the same configuration. Each task subsampled to 0 documents (0 = full); the stderr columns give the resulting precision. Producer: analysis/ple/qwen_downstream.py
